text:
sam.t: starting canary for orion9b-ql6. seeing sporadic OOMs during long chat sessions when callers request >6k tokens. root cause looks like KV cache blowup + fragmentation.
olivia.h: can you paste the stderr snippet?
sam.t: here you go:
```
E worker: RuntimeError: OOM while allocating KV cache chunk (1.1 GiB)
Traceback (most recent call last): ... RuntimeError: OOM allocating attention buffers
```
devon.p: ok. is this after the recent default bump to 4096 max_new_tokens or during ad-hoc overrides?
sam.t: defaults.yaml has max_new_tokens: 4096 for orion9b-ql6. several internal callers frequently request 8k-10k.
matt.b: two obvious levers: 1) enforce a gateway soft-cap for >6k with a friendly 409 + doc link, 2) runtime tuning: lower microbatching (microbatch_size=1) or reduce batch_window_ms so we don't aggregate huge active KV caches. tradeoffs = latency & throughput.
olivia.h: also run KV-trim/compaction heuristics. for similar 9B quant models we got good wins with kv_compact=true, eviction_threshold=0.58, trim_ratio=0.14 and prefetch=false.
devon.p: can you run a small ablation and post numbers? even 100 runs per config is fine.
sam.t: ran quick ablation (100 runs each):
- baseline (max_new_tokens=4096, microbatch=4, prefetch=true) -> 8 OOMs
- cap2048 + microbatch=1 -> 0 OOMs, tail latency +32%
- kv_compact + eviction=0.58 + trim=0.14 + microbatch=2 + prefetch=false -> 1 OOM, latency ~baseline
- evict=0.58 + microbatch=1 + batch_window_ms=12 -> 0 OOMs, latency +5%

matt.b: paste the config you tested for the middle one?
sam.t: snippet:
```json
{
  "model": "orion9b-ql6",
  "defaults": {"max_new_tokens": 4096},
  "batching": {"microbatch_size": 2, "batch_window_ms": 14},
  "prefetch": false,
  "kv": {"compact": true, "eviction_threshold": 0.58, "trim_ratio": 0.14}
}
```

olivia.h: sounds reasonable. another kernel-level tweak: lower the long-sequence attention kernel cutoff from 6k -> 4k so we avoid allocating very large temporary attention buffers by default. but that could impact quality for long-context tasks.
devon.p: if we touch kernel selection we need to run our eval suite for long-context summarization/QA to ensure no regressions.
ops-bot: canary deploy queued for orion9b-ql6 tag canary/kv-compact-0.58 at 2024-12-02T10:10:00Z :rocket:
matt.b: did you run the regressions?
sam.t: kicked off full regression + long-context QA sweep. ETA ~28m. early results from 10-minute smoke: kv_compact config shows no meaningful quality delta on gist summarization, prefetch=false avoids most OOMs in small sample.
olivia.h: keep an eye on multi-turn conversational hallucination metrics — quant variants sometimes drift when changing prefetch or kernel paths.
devon.p: also add an automated alarm: if OOM_count / 1h > 0.4% then auto-fallback to orion9b-16q and page the oncall.
matt.b: agree. and we should add a per-model hard_cap in the manifest at 10k and soft_cap at 6k at the gateway. dedicated customers can request whitelist for higher hard_cap.
sam.t: evals complete: full suite shows kv_compact + prefetch=false -> ROUGE delta 0.07% on long-summary tests; hallucination metrics flat. recommended rollout: kv_compact + eviction_threshold=0.58 + trim_ratio=0.14 to canary 10% traffic, keep default max_new_tokens=4096, add gateway soft-cap at 6k, manifest hard_cap=10k, and OOM alarm + auto-fallback.
matt.b: sounds good. will open PRs for manifest + gateway + alarm. tagging @olivia.h for eval signoff and @devon.p for rollout ops.
ops-bot: canary ramp to 10% scheduled at 2024-12-02T10:40:00Z  monitoring hooks attached.
olivia.h: ran the targeted hallucination check for the canary config: no regression, recommend proceeding.
devon.p: rolling to 10% now. monitoring dashboards configured for token-length histogram, per-model OOM_count, and tail latency. auto-fallback policy in place.
matt.b: followups: PR #5124 (manifest/gateway), playbook update for long-gen customers, support KB, and a short note to partners about the soft-cap behavior.
sam.t: assigned followups and will close when canary stable. will post a short summary in release-war-room after 2h. :white_check_mark:
